referenceFunction.generalComment: The multioutput-process "treatment CRT glass" delivers the co-products "disposal, treatment of CRT glass”, "glass cullets, panel glass, for CRT glass production, at plant", "glass cullets, funnel glass, for CRT glass production, at plant" and "glass cullets, mixed glass, for CRT glass production, at plant". The allocation is done 100% to the disposal process.; UUID: 060d6209-893a-497b-8e43-b12003d1106c
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset represents the treatment of CRT tubes. It includes infrastructure, energy consumption, water consumption and an estimation of the efforts for transportation. The process has no emissions to air / water.
